editorial_brief.answer: Select legal entity, role, reporting basis and period before applying the ten bounded questions.

findings.claim: Separate exchange from contribution before considering restrictions. For a contribution, a barrier plus return/release right creates a condition; a purpose restriction alone does not. Federal cost allowability is a separate compliance question from revenue recognition.
findings.qualification: Nongovernmental nonprofit recipient; separately identify federal-award recipient/pass-through; FASB Topic 958; 2 CFR Part 200 award compliance

findings.claim: Governmental funds use current financial resources and modified accrual; government-wide governmental activities use economic resources and accrual. Capital assets, long-term debt and timing differences need an explicit bridge. GASB 103 requires original-to-final and final-to-actual budget comparisons for the selected budgetary schedules.
findings.qualification: State/local general governmental fund and government-wide governmental activities; GASB 34 and 103

findings.claim: Establish the federal reporting entity and applicable standards first. The SFFAS 53 reconciliation bridges net cost and net outlays through accrual and other differences. Budget authority, obligations, cash outlays and accrual expense represent different events and need separately supported schedules.
findings.qualification: US federal component reporting entity; FASAB SFFAS 34 and 53

findings.claim: Select domicile, license, return purpose and state practices before using the NAIC hierarchy. SSAPs occupy Level 1; a lower-level interpretation cannot override them. Maintain a separate GAAP-to-statutory adjustment ledger with state practice evidence; this foundation does not determine any particular reserve or admitted asset.
findings.qualification: Insurer reporting to state insurance regulator; NAIC SAP plus state prescribed/permitted practices; separate US GAAP statements

findings.claim: Confirm institution eligibility and reporting quarter, including domestic-office, size and other exclusions. Map the eligible regulatory return to the institution ledger; retain schedule and glossary context. A nonbank lender, servicer, fund or adviser cannot inherit this return solely from a finance industry label.
findings.qualification: Eligible domestic bank or savings association; distinguish lender and servicer; FFIEC 051 regulatory reporting with separate GAAP policies

findings.claim: Yes. Custody includes possession or authority to obtain client assets, while legal and beneficial ownership require separate evidence. The adviser custody rule addresses qualified custody, notices, statements and examination subject to exceptions. A client security is not made the adviser's own investment by appearing on its custody feed.
findings.qualification: SEC registered or required-to-register investment adviser with client funds/securities; Investment Advisers Act custody rule; separate entity financial reporting

findings.claim: Establish FERC jurisdiction and the applicable accounting system, then identify the ratemaking action and cost population supporting account 182.3. Reconcile rate-order costs, recovery and disallowances to the regulatory ledger. This is a regulatory accounting route; GAAP eligibility and recoverability require separate authority and facts.
findings.qualification: FERC-jurisdictional electric public utility/licensee; 18 CFR Part 101 regulatory accounting; separate financial reporting framework

findings.claim: The cited regulation routes successful efforts to ASC 932. Under its full-cost provisions, country cost centers and acquisition/exploration/development costs are distinct from production expense, amortization and ceiling review. A contractor supplying drilling services must not adopt the owner's resource-cost model based solely on its activity code.
findings.qualification: SEC reporting oil/gas resource owner; exclude support contractor; Regulation S-X 4-10; ASC 932 route for successful efforts

findings.claim: Lock provider CCN, component, period and applicable form revision. Cost finding recasts financial accounts using direct allocation and indirect proration; claims and payment extracts require a documented bridge to that ledger. Retain cost-center reclasses, exclusions and settlement support. The filing deadline rule and extraordinary-circumstance extension are separate from payment entitlement.
findings.qualification: Medicare hospital/provider using CMS-2552-10; 42 CFR 413.24 and CMS hospital cost-report instructions; separate GAAP ledger

findings.claim: Separate the promised license, territory, term and other services before measuring consideration. The original amendment distinguishes general variable consideration from the sales/usage royalty exception for IP licenses, recognized no earlier than the later of the relevant usage/sale and satisfaction of the related performance obligation. A rights intermediary or licensee needs its own role analysis.
findings.qualification: Nongovernmental US GAAP intellectual-property licensor; ASC 606 research route using original ASU 2014-09 text
